title: Mobile TTS Audio Pipeline Latency & Syllable Under-Timing Causes Story Word Highlight to Run Ahead
description: On Android native speech playback via Speech.speak(), audio hardware buffer latency (~250-300ms) delay is not accounted for upon onStart, and syllables are timed at 0.35s/rate instead of realistic Indic akshara duration (0.48-0.55s), causing text highlights to advance prematurely before the voice speaks the word.
userImpact: User observes: 'avaj late ave chhe ane highlighte text agal jatu re chhe' (voice comes late and highlight moves ahead).
reproduction: Open any Hindi or Gujarati story in Expo Go on Android device, press play, observe the highlighted word racing ahead of the spoken audio by 1 to 2 words.
recommendation: Introduce a 280ms Android hardware output latency compensation buffer before initiating synthetic syllable tracking, calibrate Indic syllable timing constant to 0.48s / effectiveRate, and synchronize to native onBoundary events monotonically.

title: Animal Sound Playback Fallback Silent Failure on Expo Go Android Audio Node Allocation
description: When playing wildlife sounds on Expo Go, if HTML5 Audio is unavailable or expo-av Audio.Sound encounters an unhandled exception or concurrent playback limit, the animal sound fails silently without informing the user or falling back to TTS onomatopoeia.
userImpact: Kids tap 'અસલી અવાજ' (Real Voice) and nothing plays on certain devices.
reproduction: Rapidly click Real Voice button on an animal lesson in Expo Go.
recommendation: Wrap expo-av Audio.Sound in try/catch with fallback to TTS onomatopoeia spoken aloud in Gujarati/Hindi if audio load fails.

title: Harsh Horizontal Gradient Cut Line Visible Above Bottom Navigation Bar
description: navShield uses a high-opacity yellow SVG LinearGradient (#FEF9C3 to #FDE68A at 0.85-0.98 opacity) that creates a visible horizontal edge cutting across cards on the Home screen.
userImpact: Visually jarring cut line above the bottom navbar reported in user screenshot 1: 'niche bottom navbar upar direct cut horixzontal line dekhay chhe e saru nathi lagtu'.
reproduction: Open Home screen, scroll cards halfway down, observe sharp yellow dividing line across screen above the bottom tab bar.
recommendation: Remove the harsh yellow navShield. Use a modern translucent glassmorphic dock with soft clay shadow (rgba(0,0,0,0.06)) and rounded corners.

title: Animal Character Icon Mismatch on Real Voice Button (Eagle & Vulture showing Crow Icon)
description: The Real Voice button resolved icons via STORY_CHARACTER_IMAGES['🦅'], which was mapped to 3d_crow.png. Eagle and Vulture showed a black crow image instead of their respective bird character artwork.
userImpact: User screenshot 4 & 5: Eagle and Vulture display a black crow inside the circular button.
reproduction: Navigate to lesson 'an-eagle' or 'an-vulture', inspect the circular 'અસલી અવાજ' button.
recommendation: Pass characterImage directly from getLessonImageSource(currentLesson) to LessonActionSection so the button icon always matches the lesson card illustration 100%.

title: Animal Sound Info Lookup Misses Adapted Grade 3-5 Lessons for Fox and Buffalo
description: In older age group adaptations (Grade 3-5), animal lesson IDs and title variations may bypass keyword matching if soundKey is not populated or category is overridden.
userImpact: Fox (શિયાળ) and Buffalo (ભેંસ) in Grade 3-5 do not show the Real Voice button (user screenshots 2 & 3).
reproduction: Set age group to Grade 3-5, open Fox or Buffalo lesson, observe absence of Real Voice button.
recommendation: Ensure getAnimalSoundInfo checks all language names, sound keys, and lesson IDs with fallback wildcard matching.

title: Django Production Settings Default to DEBUG = True
description: backend/config/settings.py has DEBUG = True hardcoded, which exposes stack traces, database schema, and internal paths if deployed without explicit environment override.
userImpact: Security risk: sensitive server diagnostics could leak to unauthorized users in production.
reproduction: Check backend/config/settings.py line 28: DEBUG = os.getenv('DJANGO_DEBUG', 'True') == 'True'.
recommendation: Set default DJANGO_DEBUG to False and require explicit True in local development environment.

title: AsyncStorage State Collision Between Guest Mode and Authenticated Child Profiles
description: When switching between Guest Mode (@kidszone_guest_mode) and a logged-in user profile, local coin balances, badges, and completed lesson IDs can collide or fail to reset properly.
userImpact: Progress made in guest mode may overwrite or mingle with another child's profile progress upon login.
reproduction: Complete 3 lessons in guest mode, sign into an existing parent account with child profile, verify if guest coins persist.
recommendation: Namespace all profile-specific progress keys with the active profile UUID or 'guest_default'.

title: 196.5 MB Uncompressed Image Asset Footprint Causes Memory Pressure and Slow Startup in Expo Go
description: The assets/images directory contains 393 PNG and JPG images totaling 196.5 MB. Bundling and decoding these assets in Expo Go dev mode causes high GC pressure and slow screen transitions.
userImpact: User feedback: 'app slow bav lage chhe expo thi solution ke' (app feels very slow on Expo).
reproduction: Launch app in Expo Go on mid-range Android phone, monitor RAM usage in Metro terminal.
recommendation: Enable Hermes JS engine (completed), compress PNGs with pngquant/WebP, and implement image lazy loading with expo-image.

title: Uncancelled setInterval in ScreenWellnessService Can Leak Timer Across App Sessions
description: this.timerInterval is instantiated in startMonitoring without robust cleanup on app backgrounding or context teardown.
userImpact: Potential battery drain and background timer firing when app is minimized.
reproduction: Start session, lock screen for 10 minutes, unlock and check CPU wakeups.
recommendation: Ensure AppState change listener clears timerInterval when app enters 'background' or 'inactive' state.

title: API Service Lacks Offline Request Queue for Quiz & Story Progress Sync
description: If a child completes a quiz or story page while offline, the POST request to /api/progress/ fails immediately without enqueueing for background retry.
userImpact: Children playing in offline mode lose star rewards and completion badges once the app is restarted.
reproduction: Enable Airplane mode, finish a story, restart app, observe unrecorded completion in progress screen.
recommendation: Implement an offline mutation queue in AsyncStorage that drains when NetInfo reports connected.

title: Indic Unicode Combining Marks & Matras Split Risk During Regex Word Boundaries
description: Naively splitting Gujarati (\u0A80-\u0AFF) or Devanagari (\u0900-\u097F) words using whitespace regex without combining mark guards can separate halant/virama conjuncts from base consonants.
userImpact: Word highlighting occasionally highlights a partial syllable or splits matras from the consonant.
reproduction: Test story with complex conjuncts like 'પ્રકાશ' or 'કૃત્ય', inspect character span indices.
recommendation: Use Intl.Segmenter with granularity: 'word' or Unicode akshara cluster regex ([\u0A80-\u0AFF]+).

title: Tracing Canvas Coordinate Scaling Drift on High Device Pixel Ratio (DPR 3x/4x) Displays
description: Touch coordinates in onPanResponderMove are mapped to SVG path points without devicePixelRatio normalization on certain Android display scaling modes.
userImpact: Drawn stroke appears offset by a few pixels from the child's fingertip on high-density displays.
reproduction: Test finger tracing on an Android device with display zoom set to 'Largest'.
recommendation: Use nativeEvent.locationX and locationY relative to canvas layout width/height rather than screen pageX/pageY.

title: Parental Gate Multiplication Challenge Can Be Bypassed by Repeated Guesses
description: Parent gate uses simple multiplication problems (e.g. 7 x 8) without rate-limiting incorrect attempts, allowing older children to brute-force access to settings.
userImpact: Children could bypass parental controls and change screen time or profile settings.
reproduction: Enter wrong answers repeatedly on the parent gate modal; no lockout occurs.
recommendation: Implement exponential backoff or 3-attempt timeout before regenerating a new math challenge.

title: Non-Virtualized Grid in All-Lessons Category Causes Frame Drops During Rapid Scroll
description: Category lists with over 50 items render directly in a ScrollView instead of a virtualized FlatList or FlashList, causing 60fps drops on budget mobile devices.
userImpact: Stuttering and lag when browsing large categories (e.g., Animals, Vegetables, English Letters).
reproduction: Scroll quickly through the full Animals category on an entry-level Android phone.
recommendation: Replace ScrollView grid mapping with FlatList using initialNumToRender={12} and maxToRenderPerBatch={12}.

title: Silent Bare Exception Swallowing in Backend Questions View
description: An except Exception: pass block in backend/questions/views.py swallows database connection and query errors silently without logging.
userImpact: Difficult forensic debugging if questions fail to load or return empty arrays.
reproduction: Trigger a database timeout on questions API endpoint; server returns 200 with empty list instead of logging 500 error.
recommendation: Replace bare pass with logger.exception('Failed to retrieve questions') and return structured error response.

title: Native Voice Pitch Inversion on Android Devices When Female Voice is Inferred
description: Android voice identifiers rarely contain 'female' or 'male' in their system strings, causing getCalibratedPitch to default to female pitch adjustments on male system voices.
userImpact: Voice occasionally sounds unnaturally high-pitched or chipmunk-like on certain Android TTS engines.
reproduction: Change voice pitch setting to 1.2 on Android, speak a Gujarati lesson name.
recommendation: Clamp pitch calibration to [0.95, 1.15] range to prevent voice distortion.

title: Uncancelled setTimeout in Coloring Screen Upon Early Navigation
description: setTimeout timer inside coloring completion handler does not cancel if the child presses the back button before the timer fires, causing memory leaks.
userImpact: React state update warning on unmounted component.
reproduction: Complete a coloring page and immediately tap back arrow within 1 second.
recommendation: Store timer ID in a ref and call clearTimeout in useEffect cleanup.

title: Uncancelled setTimeout for Hint Bubble in TracingCanvas
description: setTimeout(() => setHint(null), 2500) fires after component unmounts if user exits tracing mode quickly.
userImpact: Console warning and minor memory leak.
reproduction: Open tracing modal, wait 0.5s, close tracing modal.
recommendation: Store hint timer in ref and clear on unmount.

title: Garden Water Animation Timer Fires on Unmounted Screen
description: Water droplet timeout in garden.tsx runs unconditionally without unmount check.
userImpact: Warning: Can't perform a React state update on an unmounted component.
reproduction: Water a flower in the virtual garden and tap back immediately.
recommendation: Add isMounted ref guard or clearTimeout in return function.

title: Alert.alert Missing Gujarati and Hindi Translations on Offline Download Action
description: Several Alert.alert dialogs show English-only strings when triggering worksheet download or offline pack caching.
userImpact: Non-English speaking Gujarati and Hindi children/parents see English system alerts.
reproduction: Switch language to Gujarati, trigger download alert.
recommendation: Use localized alert strings from t() helper.

title: Bottom Action Buttons Text Clipping on Narrow Screens (<360px Width)
description: The 3 bottom navigation buttons ('← પાછળ', 'પૂરું થયું', 'આગળ →') can wrap or clip text on narrow displays (e.g. 320px width).
userImpact: Button labels become partially cut off on budget devices.
reproduction: Set device viewport width to 320px in DevTools.
recommendation: Use flexShrink: 1, adjust horizontal padding, and set numberOfLines={1} with minimum font scale.

title: Asset Compression Pipeline with WebP Conversion for 196.5 MB Asset Directory
description: Converting all 393 PNG/JPG assets to modern WebP format with quality 85 will reduce asset bundle size from 196.5 MB to ~35 MB (82% reduction).
userImpact: Dramatic reduction in app install size, instant screen loads, and zero memory stutter on mobile.
reproduction: Inspect current assets/images folder size: 196.5 MB.
recommendation: Run automated image compression script converting assets to WebP.

title: Stale Session ID Guard Discards Newer Speech Sessions During Story Page Turns
description: In WordGlowReader.tsx, activeSessionIdRef.current strictly rejected any event where evt.sessionId !== activeSessionIdRef.current. When turning pages, newer speech requests (higher session IDs) were rejected as 'stale', causing word highlighting to freeze or fail on page turns.
userImpact: Highlighted word freezes or stops moving when child navigates to the next page of a story.
reproduction: Open a story, let page 1 read 2 words, tap 'આગળ' (next page), observe text highlighting failing to start on page 2.
recommendation: Accept any session ID >= activeSessionIdRef.current and reset activeSessionIdRef.current on handleSpeechStart.

title: expo-av.Audio.Sound Fallback Bypassed on Expo Go when expo-audio is Present but Unlinked
description: soundEffects.ts checked if (!createAudioPlayerFn && ExpoAvAudio?.Sound). If createAudioPlayerFn was defined but threw a native error on Expo Go, execution never fell back to expo-av.Audio.Sound.
userImpact: Animal sound fails to play on certain Android Expo Go builds even though the mp3 file is valid.
reproduction: Launch app in Expo Go with unlinked expo-audio native module, tap Real Voice button.
recommendation: Check if (!this.currentAnimalSound && ExpoAvAudio?.Sound) so fallback triggers whenever the primary player fails.

title: Mascot Floating Button Overlaps Bottom Navigation Dock on Mobile Viewports
description: styles.container had bottom: 84 on MascotGuide.tsx, causing the circular floating monkey button to collide with the top-right corner of the floating bottom nav bar (visible in user screenshot 1).
userImpact: Visual overlap between the floating mascot and the bottom tab bar.
reproduction: Open Home screen on a standard mobile display, inspect bottom-right corner.
recommendation: Increase bottom offset to 96px (and 84px on compact) to float cleanly above the bottom navbar.

title: Side-Effect Scheduled Inside React State Setter Reducer
description: In app/coloring.tsx, a setTimeout() call was scheduled inside the setFills() updater function, violating React pure component lifecycle principles.
userImpact: Potential duplicate completion handlers in concurrent rendering mode.
reproduction: Rapidly color shapes in coloring screen.
recommendation: Compute nextFills outside setFills and schedule completion side-effects in component scope.

title: Missing useFocusEffect Audio Cleanup Leaves Lesson Audio Playing After Navigation
description: app/lessons/index.tsx lacked useFocusEffect to silence active quick-play speech when the user navigated deeper into the stack (/lessons/[id]).
userImpact: Quick lesson pronunciation continues playing in the background after opening lesson detail.
reproduction: Tap quick speak button on a lesson card and immediately tap the card to open detail.
recommendation: Add useFocusEffect hook that calls audioService.stop() and soundEffects.stopAnimalSound() on blur.

title: Legacy Prototype App Name 'SmartKids' Displayed Instead of 'KidsZone'
description: Header.tsx and app/index.tsx had 'SmartKids' hardcoded in the header brand container instead of 'KidsZone'.
userImpact: Brand inconsistency for children and parents viewing top navigation header.
reproduction: Render Header with showBack={false}.
recommendation: Update brand title to 'KidsZone'.

title: Static API_BASE_URL Constant Evaluates to 127.0.0.1, Breaking All Mobile Device Network Calls
description: apiService.ts imported and used static API_BASE_URL which resolves to 127.0.0.1:8000. On physical Android/iOS devices running Expo Go over Wi-Fi, 127.0.0.1 points to the phone rather than the dev machine, causing all API requests to fail immediately.
userImpact: Lessons, badges, rhymes, stickers, and game questions fail to fetch from backend on physical devices, falling back to offline data only.
reproduction: Run app on physical phone connected via Expo Go QR code, inspect network requests to /lessons/.
recommendation: Use dynamic getApiBaseUrl() which extracts development PC LAN IP automatically.

title: Google TTS 200-Character Overflow on Long Hindi/Gujarati Sentences
description: audioService.splitIntoSpeechChunks only split text by full stops (।, ., !). If a single sentence was longer than 180 chars, it was sent un-chunked to Google Translate TTS which enforces a strict 200-char limit, resulting in HTTP 404 failure.
userImpact: Long descriptive story sentences or complex sentences fail to play audio on web or proxy modes.
reproduction: Pass a 210-character Hindi sentence without a danda into audioService.splitIntoSpeechChunks(text, 180).
recommendation: Sub-divide sentences exceeding maxLen at comma, semicolon, or clause boundaries.

title: Multi-Touch Simultaneous Answer Race Condition in 2-Player Duel Mode
description: If Player 1 and Player 2 tapped answers nearly simultaneously, both saw roundCompleted === false before React re-rendered, scheduling two advanceRound timers and skipping questions with double coin awards.
userImpact: Duel mode skips rounds or gives double points during intense 2-player taps.
reproduction: Press P1 and P2 buttons with two fingers at the exact same moment in duel mode.
recommendation: Use roundCompletedRef to synchronously lock answers and use functional state updater in setCurrentRound.

title: Garden Plant Maturity Celebration Side-Effect Scheduled Inside Array.map()
description: In app/garden.tsx, setTimeout(() => addCoins(25), 300) was scheduled directly inside plants.map(). If the map function re-executed or batched, duplicate rewards could be awarded.
userImpact: Multiple celebration popups or bonus coin triggers on plant maturity.
reproduction: Water a plant to full bloom and observe side-effect scheduling.
recommendation: Detect maturity outside the mapping transform and manage timers via gardenTimerRef.

title: Story 1 Scene 2 Parenthetical Annotation Desynchronized Text-Audio Highlight Progression
description: In src/data/storiesData.ts line 73 and backend export line 38355, the text 'કૂંજો (ઘડો)' contained parentheses. normalizeSpeechText wiped out '(ઘડો)' during speech synthesis while WordGlowReader retained '(ઘડો)' as a visual word span, throwing all subsequent words in the scene out of sync with the audio.
userImpact: Word glow highlight in Story 1 Scene 2 gets permanently stuck or lags by a full word relative to the audio narrator.
reproduction: Open Story 1 ('The Clever Crow') Scene 2 and listen to narration in Gujarati.
recommendation: Replace 'માટીનો કૂંજો (ઘડો)' with standard natural 'માટીનો ઘડો' across frontend and backend exports.

title: Indiscriminate Regex Over-Stripping of Indic Parenthetical Text in normalizeSpeechText
description: In audioService.ts, clean = clean.replace(/\s*\([^)]*\)/g, '') stripped any parenthetical text indiscriminately in Gujarati and Hindi instead of only Latin/English glosses. Any Indic word placed inside parentheses was deleted from speech audio while remaining on screen.
userImpact: Spoken sentence word count fails to match visual paragraph word count whenever parentheses are used.
reproduction: Call normalizeSpeechText('માટીનો કૂંજો (ઘડો) દેખાયો', 'gu').
recommendation: Scope parenthetical stripping to Latin/English characters (/\s*\([A-Za-z\s-]+\)/g) so Indic content is never removed from speech.

title: Screen Time Lockout and Eye Care Overlays Allowed Background Audio Bleed
description: When daily screen time expired or eye-care break was triggered, ScreenWellnessOverlay did not invoke audioService.stop(), soundEffects.stopAnimalSound(), or soundEffects.stopBgm(). Any active story narration or rhyme audio continued playing under the modal.
userImpact: Loud background story or rhyme audio keeps playing after the screen time lockout modal covers the screen.
reproduction: Let daily screen time expire or trigger eye-care break while a story is narrating.
recommendation: Call audioService.stop(), soundEffects.stopAnimalSound(), and soundEffects.stopBgm() in onDailyLimitReached and onEyeCareDue.

title: Vulture Lesson Keyword Fallback Missing in getLessonImageSource
description: While eagle was explicitly handled in hasWord('eagle') heuristic checks, vulture ('vulture' / 'ગીધ' / 'गिद्ध') was absent from getLessonImageSource keyword fallbacks, relying only on direct ID lookup.
userImpact: Any non-standard lesson card referencing vulture falls back to generic Unsplash image instead of authentic bundled 3D vulture artwork.
reproduction: Call getLessonImageSource({ title: 'Vulture • ગીધ' }) without ID.
recommendation: Add hasWord('vulture') || hasWord('ગીધ') || hasWord('गिद्ध') to return ANIMAL_CHARACTER_IMAGES['vulture'].

title: Unsequenced Concurrent saveProgress Operations Cause Intermittent Data Loss in AsyncStorage
description: storageService.saveProgress did not sequence asynchronous read-modify-write tasks. When multiple actions called saveProgress concurrently (e.g. rapid coin earnings + game completion), both read the same base progress snapshot and the latter write clobbered earlier progress updates.
userImpact: Intermittent loss of earned coins, stars, or newly marked lessons during rapid multi-feature interactions.
reproduction: Trigger addCoins() and markLessonCompleted() concurrently in rapid succession.
recommendation: Implement a sequential promise queue (saveQueue) ensuring strictly atomic, serialized progress persistence.

title: Multi-Touch Simultaneous Option Taps Trigger Duplicate Advance & Answer Evaluation Across All 16 Mini-Games
description: In app/games/[type].tsx, handleOptionSelect and handleFindObjectOptionSelect relied solely on asynchronous React state (isAnswered) to prevent double taps. Two simultaneous touches registered within the same event frame, causing double bubble pops, duplicate score additions, and conflicting advance timers.
userImpact: Duplicate scores, erratic question skipping, or simultaneous right/wrong feedback when tapping with two fingers.
reproduction: Tap two option cards simultaneously with two fingers in any mini-game.
recommendation: Introduce isAnsweredRef to lock answers synchronously before React state updates.

title: Floating Unreferenced Speech and Memory Match Card-Flip Timers Leak State on Unmounted Screens
description: setTimeout calls for feedback speech (lines 415, 448) and memory match card flips (lines 670, 689) were unreferenced floating timers. Navigating back to the menu while timers were pending resulted in speech playing over the menu and state updates on unmounted components.
userImpact: Congratulatory praise audio plays unexpectedly on the games menu after leaving a game.
reproduction: Answer a question or flip cards in Memory Match and immediately press Back.
recommendation: Store timeout IDs in speechTimerRef and memoryTimerRef, and clear them on unmount and useFocusEffect blur.

title: Missing Double-Purchase Lock and Unlocked Check Causes Multiple Coin Deductions on Rapid Taps
description: In app/avatar.tsx, buyItem did not check if the item was already unlocked or currently purchasing. Rapid taps on 'Buy' triggered multiple concurrent spendCoins() invocations, charging the child multiple times for the same cosmetic item.
userImpact: Children lose coins due to double-spending on accidental rapid taps in avatar shop.
reproduction: Rapidly double-tap the 'Buy' button on any locked avatar item.
recommendation: Check unlockedItems.includes(item.id) and guard with isPurchasingRef.

title: Redundant Duplicate onClaim Call Dispatched During Daily Mystery Box Opening
description: DailyMysteryModal.handleOpenBox invoked onClaim(REWARD_STARS, REWARD_COINS, sticker.id) and then immediately called onClaim(15, 25, sticker.id) again five lines later, dispatching duplicate state updates to the parent component.
userImpact: Redundant asynchronous storage writes and potential double increment of mystery rewards claimed count.
reproduction: Tap 'Open My Gift' in DailyMysteryBox and inspect dispatched onClaim calls.
recommendation: Remove the redundant second onClaim invocation so reward is claimed exactly once.

title: Mobile Indic Syllable Constant Overestimation Causes Story Word Highlighting to Lag Far Behind Spoken Voice
description: In audioService.narrateStory, secondsPerUnit for Indic languages was set to 0.49s/rate, whereas real Google TTS speaks Indic syllables at ~0.32s. Consequently, on mobile devices, the sentence audio finished speaking 2.5s earlier while the visual word highlight was still slowly moving through earlier words.
userImpact: User reported: 'stories ma highlight text ane audio match nathi thato haju pan' (Story text highlight and audio do not match).
reproduction: Open any Gujarati story on Android Expo Go, start narration, observe visual highlight lagging 2-3 words behind the spoken audio.
recommendation: Calibrate secondsPerUnit for Indic languages to 0.32s / effectiveRate and reduce Android hardware startup latency compensation to 240ms.

title: Animal Action Button Fallback Mismatch for Birds with Non-Standard Emojis
description: STORY_CHARACTER_IMAGES lacked explicit mappings for 'vulture' and 'eagle', causing lessons falling back through emoji lookups to show inaccurate images or crows on circular action buttons.
userImpact: User screenshots 1 and 2: Eagle and Vulture showed a black crow in the 'અસલી અવાજ' button.
reproduction: Navigate to lesson 'an-eagle' or 'an-vulture' in Grade 3-5 mode and inspect action button icon.
recommendation: Register 3D character renders for eagle and vulture in STORY_CHARACTER_IMAGES and prefer direct soundKey resolution in LessonActionSection.

title: Unvirtualized Category Lesson Grid & 200MB Uncompressed Asset Payload Causing Perceived Slowness in Expo Go
description: In Expo Go development mode, bundling and streaming 197MB of 1024x1024 assets over local Wi-Fi, combined with unvirtualized ScrollView grids mounting 50-100 cards simultaneously in DEV mode (__DEV__=true), causes heavy RAM allocation and UI frame drops on physical devices.
userImpact: User reported: 'app slow bav lage chhe expo thi solution ke' (App feels very slow in Expo, what is the solution?).
reproduction: Open heavy categories like Animals or GK in Expo Go on mid-range Android phone and scroll rapidly.
recommendation: Provide user architectural solution: 1) Run standalone release APK build (Hermes bytecode AOT compiled, assets bundled into APK), 2) Batch/memoize card rendering in category grids.
